prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept game pet.
Create ONE finished SD sloth mascot pet asset for a Korean game, matching the existing pet asset in reference image 2.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1: ONLY human facial identity, straight black bangs, expression, round thin silver glasses with teal lens reflections, and glasses-holding gesture. This is the user's own chosen face reference. Preserve these recognizable features.
Image 2: PRIMARY proportions, composition and rendering-style reference. It is an existing approved rabbit-costume SD pet with a large human face, enormous soft hood, tiny plump standing body and little paws. Copy that visual design language and scale relationships, not that person's face or rabbit species.

LATEST USER CORRECTION: "SD느낌으로. 기존에 만든거 펫 리소스 확인해봐." They rejected a realistic full-sized person sitting in a sloth costume. The result must now look like an SD GAME PET, approximately two heads tall, with the huge hood-and-face mass occupying about 55 percent of the whole character height, and a tiny round pear-shaped body and very short feet beneath. Follow image 2's small adorable standing pet silhouette.

SUBJECT:
A cute, plump, grey-brown SLOTH COSTUME pet standing front-facing, with the human face from image 1 visibly nestled inside the hood opening. Broad rounded sloth hood: cream face patch with characteristic dark brown sloth eye stripes and a tiny dark nose above the opening, tiny unobtrusive ears, soft fluffy taupe fur. The human face is the central readable feature; sloth markings belong to the fabric hood above and around it, never painted on the person's skin. Oatmeal oval belly, tiny chubby feet with three rounded pale claws per foot, short padded arms lifted beside the glasses. Small human fingertips emerging from plush sleeves gently pinch both sides of the same silver glasses, echoing the reference gesture, with anatomically coherent fingers. Both short arms remain close to the face in a compact pet silhouette.

FACE:
Faithfully preserve the person in image 1: same eye shape and spacing, eyelids, nose, small closed-mouth smile, cheek and chin shapes, frontal gaze, straight black bangs and round silver/teal glasses. Keep the naturally recognizable, softly rendered reference face, as image 2 does with its human face. Enlarge the WHOLE head relative to the pet body, not individual eyes or facial features. No generic anime face, no huge invented eyes, no new expression, no face borrowed from image 2. Keep visible black hair tucked naturally within the hood, soft continuous strands.

STYLE:
Match image 2's polished SD pet illustration / collectible plush figure rendering: coherent soft shading, rounded toy-like volume, finely brushed soft fur, compact appealing silhouette. This must read as a deliberately SD game companion, not an ordinary real adult in a long onesie and not a photographed seated human. No long human torso, normal-sized adult arms, visible human legs, realistic seated-body proportions or big elongated slippers.

OUTPUT:
Single square transparent PNG; full standing character centered with all hood, hands, feet and claws visible and 6-8 percent clear margin. Clean genuine transparent alpha background, no black or brown backdrop, no checkerboard baked in, no room, no floor or scene. No text, nametag, broadcast overlay, watermarks, logos, collar, chains, flower, headphones, additional characters or props. Preserve the original reference files; create a new image.

references.role: existing SD pet proportions and costume style
